review_candidates.title: Application Developer Supervisor-(Software)
review_candidates.description: IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on software development experience is mandatory . Minimum 2+ years in a Senior, Team Lead, or Supervisory role is mandatory . Fresh graduates, undergraduates, and non-technical applicants will be automatically disqualified . About the Role: We are looking for a hands-on Application Developer Supervisor to lead daily execution, deliver full-stack features, integrate AI/LLM tools, and mentor developers while working closely with the Software Development Senior Supervisor. Key Responsibilities: Lead day-to-day execution of development tasks and code quality. Design and deliver full-stack features from backend (.NET Core) to frontend (React/Angular). Build and integrate AI/LLM capabilities and AI coding assistants into applications. Review code, perform unit/integration testing, and maintain secure software standards. Troubleshoot production issues and improve system performance. Mentor junior/mid-level developers and foster their technical growth. Requirements & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of total software development experience. 2+ years in a Senior or Leadership/Supervisory role. Strong proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and REST APIs . Solid experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server . Practical knowledge of React or Angular . Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies . Hands-on experience with AI/LLM integrations and AI tools. Fluent in English (spoken and written).
